items.title: If the cohomology functors on an object commute with direct sums then the extension by zero of the structure sheaf is compact
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-cohomology.tex (Cohomology on Sites)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file sites-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma gives a criterion for j_{U!}O_U to be compact in D^+(O): the cohomology functors on U must commute with direct sums (statement lines 14066-14075). The proof (proof lines 14077-14106) reduces the Hom-statement to evaluation at U, verifies that direct sums of injectives are acyclic for that functor under the hypothesis, and then computes the cohomology of a bounded below direct sum by resolving it. H2: one reduction followed by an acyclicity computation, written out.
